title: research(REC): scoped thermodynamic Jacobian observation with current DAG preserved
body:
## Why
The current central DAG did not yet contain the published REC history observations from draft PR #226 or the new local thermodynamic Jacobian. This PR carries the prior REC observations forward and adds the new bounded result against the current central parent, preserving other owners' latest work.

## Changes
- Preserve the original 40 node contracts, 17 integration edges, seven authorities, all plan statuses, and the other 38 complete node objects, including the latest HE-ANG observation.
- Add only REC-LINE02 and REC-HISTORY observations; retain the fixed handoff at 0f9d9df825be1dac9ca9bdf73cdc2e8908bcba17. No assembler or renderer was run.
- Record REC-HISTORY-THERMO01 as COMPLETE_SCOPED_THERMODYNAMIC_BLOCK, parent REC-HISTORY PARTIAL: fixed incoming313, six primitive columns, outgoing314 and state313 derivatives, ionization and single-event number/energy derivatives.

## Evidence and scope
REC S2: 95d0b62daef5bc0b522c5b5a579b33bef15fc6f2, draft cosmosapjw-quantum/rec_bianchi#135, 152/152 actual Git blob/size readback PASS. A–F checks and the same independent review passed, material blockers 0; original failure, one continuation, first and corrected figures are preserved. Total 25 large RHS, 8.362847 inclusive CPU seconds and 8.336637456 execution-wall seconds, zero new IVP/native/old campaign replay.

Dropbox S2: id:BSpOijBcT10AAAAAAD_9ng, revision 65e9aa99574930af03d47, 5,842,521 bytes; SHA256 f17aa795966c9af1805b9194db42dae99f6daa266205b0293ead3bff4f2090d1. Remote whole bytes, ZIP CRC and all 485 manifest payloads PASS.

H5 physical epsilon/reference/endpoint/curvature remain null. H6 actual incident trace/geodesic/direction/frame, the full coupled H7 Jacobian and consistent J_s/K_s binding remain open. The old RESP01 K0 certificate is not transferred. Physical HOLD, U5 holds, production NOT_APPROVED and REI_activation=false remain unchanged. Finite S2 records 18/20 before actual delivery closure; later REC receipts close R10/C10. Repository CI is observed separately from scoped scientific admission. This stays a draft; no merge or activation.
